periods.time: Shortly after Xiaoli releases her aura from the village

name.zh: 饕餮登上第五营地挑战史黛菈
name.en: Xiaoli Challenges Stella at Fifth Camp

periods.summary: Fu Xiaoli races up Edelberg in minutes and introduces herself as Shenlong Temple's Taotie, one of the Four Immortals. She explains that she broke Shenlong Temple's precepts because she wants to prove China's four-thousand-year martial tradition is the world's peak. Since Stella is blocking the road to Edelweiss, Xiaoli challenges her. Stella accepts, determined not to let anyone steal her promised duel.
periods.cause: Xiaoli seeks Edelweiss, while Stella's Rule of Graces trial requires her to stop all challengers from reaching Edelweiss.
periods.process: Xiaoli recognizes Stella from the Seven Stars final, identifies Alice even without armor, explains the Five Precepts and her prison escape, then manifests Banki. Stella manifests Laevateinn and prepares to fight a Desperado opponent earlier than planned.
periods.outcome: The Stella-vs-Xiaoli duel begins, forcing Stella to confront Desperado causal pressure directly.
periods.significance: Introduces Xiaoli's ideology and turns Stella's trial into the decisive awakening battle.
